summary: BioRestorative Therapies, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 14, 2026, reporting the suspension of all orders and shipments of its biocosmeceutical product lines (ExoCR and BioX) effective August 7, pending a business review and regulatory assessment. No decision to discontinue the lines has been made. The company is reviewing documentation, sourcing, and regulatory status. This operational update is not a special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. It is a routine disclosure of a business decision, with no deal terms or strategic alternatives announced. What to watch: whether the review leads to a product discontinuation, regulatory findings, or capital needs.
